title: Fjarr DataChannel envelope
description: All control/backend messages share this shape. Normative prose: docs/08-protocol.md#envelope. Unknown fields MUST be ignored (forward compatibility), therefore additionalProperties stays permissive by design.
$comment: kind=accept/feedback/result echo the request's event_id. result.payload carries ok:bool and, on failure, error:{code,message}.

blob-ref.title: Blob reference
blob-ref.description: A payload field whose bytes travel as blob frames on the capability's bulk channel. Normative prose: docs/08-protocol.md#blob-frames.

blob.description: UUIDv7 of the blob, text form

len.description: blob_len — the whole blob in bytes

type.description: media type of the bytes, e.g. text/vnd.graphviz
